g.title: Yamaha DTX-Multi 12 Purple Carbon
g.desc: DTX skin controller. Varian skin-06: body ungu (violet), pad distiker karbon (carbon fiber twill), stiker iPhone/Apple di pad 5. Tanpa script, tanpa aset eksternal.

svg.text: Preview skin-07 — Yamaha DTX-Multi 12 Purple Carbon (overlay hit area + ID kontrol)
Total kontrol: 29 (12 pad, 15 tombol, 1 knob, 1 display). Pad 13–16 tidak didukung (padSupport 12–12).
